text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data that includes correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model, which is like a set of rules. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can guess if an email is spam or not. The quality of the model is measured by its accuracy, which shows how often its predictions are correct. Good training data usually leads to better results.
